mapper.select: SELECT ticket_id FROM nw_human_handoff_tickets WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND ticket_id=#{ticket} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM nw_handoff_reply_requests WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND command_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM nw_handoff_reply_requests WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND command_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT FROM nw_handoff_reply_requests WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND ticket_id=#{ticket} ORDER BY created_at,command_id LIMIT 100
SELECT command_id FROM nw_handoff_reply_requests WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status='accepted' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_handoff_reply_requests SET status='committed',source_event_id=#{source},source_sequence=#{sequence},updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND command_id=#{id} AND status='accepted'
UPDATE nw_handoff_reply_requests SET status='rejected',error_code=#{error},updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND command_id=#{id} AND status='accepted'
